summary: New installations sign people in through the shared sign-in front, and dates read the same everywhere.

new.title: Install through the Invardia Support app
new.text: An installation can now run as the Invardia Support app. The administrators come from your answers, so no person has to sign in.

fixes.title: New installations use the shared sign-in front
fixes.text: A new installation from the website now ends on the shared sign-in front, with its own Key Vault and its own database.

fixes.title: Dates in one clear format
fixes.text: PIM Manager, the access-request portal and the PIM Activator popup show dates as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in local time, never in US format.
